newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon rises price of petrol, fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon rises price of petrol, fuel oil.

text.p: Lebanon's industry and oil ministry slightly increased the price of petrol and fuel oil on Tuesday after increases in the prices of oil products on international markets.

Oil Minister Chahe Barsoumian told reporters after a meeting with Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri that he ordered increases of 10 Lebanese pounds (0.6 cents) per litre of petrol, 25 pounds (1.6 cents) for fuel oil, as of Wednesday.

Last Tuesday, the ministry ordered similar increases which were rejected by the association of oil importing companies who demanded bigger ones to offset losses caused by the increase in international fuel prices.
The increases raised the price of super unleaded petrol to 600 pounds, regular to 590 pounds and fuel oil to 340 pounds.
Barsoumian said "the increase was a result of international increases in the prices of oil products."
